enable-versioning.description: Keep previous versions of an object in the bucket instead of overwriting it.
enable-versioning.title: Enable-Versioning

max-noncurrent-versions.description: How many noncurrent versions of one object the bucket keeps; older ones are expired. Only has effect on a bucket with versioning. Absent means the project's value. Between 1 and 1000, platform default 30.
max-noncurrent-versions.title: Max-Noncurrent-Versions

noncurrent-expire-days.description: How many days a noncurrent version is kept, on top of the count limit. Absent means the project's value, and no age limit at all when neither layer sets one. Between 1 and 3650, no platform default.
noncurrent-expire-days.title: Noncurrent-Expire-Days
